\section[prakoṣṭhaḥ]{\sk{प्रकोष्ठः} (prakoṣṭhaḥ) — a room}

\label{lesson:SA-C77-room}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for spring, then the Sanskrit for summer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{प्रकोष्ठः}}
\textbf{\sk{प्रकोष्ठः}} (\emph{prakoṣṭhaḥ}) — \textquotedblleft{}a room\textquotedblright{} of a \textbf{\sk{गृहम्}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One part of the house.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prakoṣṭhaḥ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prakoṣṭhaḥ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{prakoṣṭhaḥ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Sanskrit for spring, then the Sanskrit for summer, then say \emph{prakoṣṭhaḥ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \sk{प्रकोष्ठः} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A room\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[(dialogue)]{How are you, really? — a first pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R77-first-pass-body-and-feelings}



\begin{quote}
Name the roof, then ask where the key is.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item you have a fever; you have a cough; you have a headache; name illness; wish someone health
  \item sleep; you are hungry; you are thirsty; rest; all is well
  \item sorrow, fear, anger, shyness, joy
  \item the eye, the throat, the belly, the forehead, the tongue
  \item a nail, the knee, the back, the shoulder, the lip
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Fever? (\textbf{\sk{ज्वरः}}.) Cough? (\textbf{\sk{कासः}}.) Pain? (\textbf{\sk{पीडा}}.) Illness? (\textbf{\sk{रोगः}}.) Health? (\textbf{\sk{आरोग्यम्}}.) Sleep, hunger, thirst, rest, ease? (\textbf{\sk{निद्रा}, \sk{क्षुधा}, \sk{पिपासा}, \sk{विश्रामः}, \sk{सुखम्}}.) Sorrow, fear, anger, shyness, joy? (\textbf{\sk{दुःखम्}, \sk{भयम्}, \sk{क्रोधः}, \sk{लज्जा}, \sk{हर्षः}}.) Eye, throat, belly, forehead, tongue? (\textbf{\sk{नेत्रम्}, \sk{कण्ठः}, \sk{उदरम्}, \sk{ललाटम्}, \sk{जिह्वा}}.) Nail, knee, back, shoulder, lip? (\textbf{\sk{नखः}, \sk{जानु}, \sk{पृष्ठम्}, \sk{स्कन्धः}, \sk{ओष्ठः}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Doing and going — a second pass}

\label{lesson:SA-R77-second-pass-doing-and-going}



\begin{quote}
Say the boy runs, then say he walks.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the guest sits down; he gets up; a leaf falls
  \item mother cooks rice; the child sleeps; she washes; he brings water; she gives it to me
  \item she sings a song; he tells; the child cries; mother is calling; he bows
  \item he buys fruit; money; ask the price; ask where the shop is; a market
  \item a vehicle, a chariot, a boat, an aeroplane; he goes into the house
  \item rain; it is cold; it is hot; spring; summer
  \item a room; ask where the kitchen and the bathroom are
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Runs, walks, sits down, gets up, falls? (\textbf{\sk{धावति}, \sk{चलति}, \sk{उपविशति}, \sk{उत्तिष्ठति}, \sk{पतति}}.) Cooks, sleeps, washes, brings, gives? (\textbf{\sk{पचति}, \sk{स्वपिति}, \sk{प्रक्षालयति}, \sk{आनयति}, \sk{ददाति}}.) Sings, tells, cries, calls, bows? (\textbf{\sk{गायति}, \sk{कथयति}, \sk{रोदिति}, \sk{आह्वयति}, \sk{नमति}}.) Buys? (\textbf{\sk{क्रीणाति}}.) Money, price, shop, market? (\textbf{\sk{धनम्}, \sk{मूल्यम्}, \sk{आपणः}, \sk{विपणिः}}.) Vehicle, chariot, boat, aeroplane? (\textbf{\sk{वाहनम्}, \sk{रथः}, \sk{नौका}, \sk{विमानम्}}.) Goes in? (\textbf{\sk{प्रविशति}}.) Rain, cold, heat, spring, summer? (\textbf{\sk{वर्षा}, \sk{शीतम्}, \sk{उष्णम्}, \sk{वसन्तः}, \sk{ग्रीष्मः}}.) Room, kitchen, bathroom, roof, key? (\textbf{\sk{प्रकोष्ठः}, \sk{पाकशाला}, \sk{स्नानगृहम्}, \sk{छदिः}, \sk{कुञ्चिका}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
